one_liner: Nifty 50 and Sensex decline amid lack of major market catalysts.

drivers.title: Global Cues
drivers.detail: Market decline lacked significant identifiable catalysts.

drivers.title: FII Outflows
drivers.detail: FIIs net sellers with outflows of Rs 3,809.99 Cr.

drivers.title: Volatility
drivers.detail: India VIX decreased by 2.22%, indicating reduced volatility.

flows_line: FIIs were net sellers at Rs 3,809.99 Cr, DIIs net buyers at Rs 4,120.07 Cr.
watch_next: Tomorrow, watch for PMI data from France, Germany, and UK.
lesson_seeds: Global cues can drive markets in absence of local catalysts.
FII flows significantly impact market sentiment.
Negative market breadth often accompanies index declines.
Volatility indices can signal market sentiment changes.
